test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, LOTUS is written as NMVSU. How will TULIP be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• Consonants - (2) is added to the position value.
 
• Vowels - (2) is subtracted from the position value .​

So, 

 
• LOTUS is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a27747dc7de681dc7e4248975fe16f5af42c85967617f3f83e576b9f771ddd83.png] 

Similarly,

 
• TULIP is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2eeaa01fe307669f459280ad70813517e80b1b724d5d1a7c8790e599b225ed0d.png] 

Hence, **"VSNGR"** is the correct answer.
